title: Stratigraphy browser
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-6 met: a three-level hierarchy with a stable order, picks whose unit comes from the reference set, overlapping picks flagged on both sides, a rename that changes display only, colour as a theme token with no colour value in the source, and picks scoped to the selected well

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Wells/OgStratigraphy.cs (OgStratUnit, OgStratNode, OgWellPick, OgStratColumn, IOgStratigraphy, OgStratigraphy, BuildHierarchy, FlagOverlaps, ColourFor)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/StratigraphyPageView.cs (route 'stratigraphy': Units tree with colour chip and rename, Columns grid, Well sections grid with add-pick and overlap sentence, OgStratColour)
implementation.navigation: WellHeaderPageView has a Stratigraphy action; the page follows the shared well context
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/StratigraphyTests.cs (12, no database, incl. a source check for colour values) + StratigraphyGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.hierarchy: Group G1 -> Formations F1, F2 -> Members M1, M2 (levels 1/2/3), ordered by age code then name
integration.scoping: UWI-A returned 3 picks (then 4 after an add), UWI-B returned 1
integration.reference_unit: free text 'FREE TEXT' refused with stratigraphy-unit-unknown and the unit ids listed; M1 added successfully
integration.overlap: two picks at 1000 m are both flagged; the 1000 -> 1200 pair yields a thickness, the last pick has none
integration.rename: renaming F1 changed both picks' display to 'Formation One (renamed)' while their STRAT_UNIT_ID stayed F1, and the message reported '2 pick(s)'
integration.columns: the single STRAT_COLUMN row was listed with its name and type

gates.AC-1 The hierarchy renders at least thre: pass - BuildHierarchy groups by GROUP_CODE and orders by ORDINAL_AGE_CODE then name; the SQLite test renders Group -> Formation -> Member (levels 1/2/3) and a second build gives the same order. A cyclic GROUP_CODE terminates instead of recursing.
gates.AC-2 A pick carries a unit from the refe: pass - picks are read with STRAT_UNIT joined for their name, and AddPickAsync refuses a unit id that is not in STRAT_UNIT (stratigraphy-unit-unknown, listing the available ids). The page offers a unit picker, not a text box.
gates.AC-3 Overlapping picks are flagged: pass - picks at the same or a shallower top are both flagged with the peer's name and are not reordered; FlagOverlaps also marks a pick with no top as excluded from thickness. The SQLite test sees both picks at 1000 m flagged.
gates.AC-4 Renaming a unit does not change pic: pass - RenameUnitAsync updates only STRAT_UNIT (LONG_NAME/SHORT_NAME); picks keep STRAT_UNIT_ID and read the new name by join. The test asserts the ids are unchanged and the display name changed, and the page reports the affected pick count.
gates.AC-5 Colour comes from the unit record o: pass - a unit carries a theme token (Highlight/Info/Control/Light/Window by rank; STRAT_UNIT has no colour column) and the page resolves it to SystemColors brushes. A source test asserts neither stratigraphy file contains a #RRGGBB value or rgb( ).
gates.AC-6 Well sections are scoped to the sel: pass - LoadPicksAsync filters STRAT_WELL_SECTION by UWI; the SQLite test sees UWI-A's 3 picks and UWI-B's 1, and adding a pick changed only UWI-A.

limits: No lexicon overlay: the external IStratigraphicLexicon package is not referenced, so raw reference-table names are shown with a notice (the plan's 'no lexicon' state).
STRAT_UNIT has no colour column, so colour is a theme token chosen by rank; a per-unit colour would need a column or a lexicon.
Base depth and thickness are derived from the next pick's top; NET and NTG columns do not exist in STRAT_WELL_SECTION, so they are not shown.
Regional columns are listed without their unit sets because there is no column-to-unit link table in this model.
Unit editing is rename only; the hierarchy order follows ORDINAL_AGE_CODE and is not edited as a number, and drag-free reordering is not built.
Picks can be added but not edited, deleted or imported; the optional import from the plan is not built.
The page is exercised by construction and by unit/integration tests; no automated click drives the tabs.
